annotation.title_clean: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards simplifying and reducing the burden of the rules on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices, and amending Regulation (EU) 2022/123 and Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
annotation.title_en: Proposal for a Regulation amending Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and (EU) 2017/746 as regards simplifying and reducing the burden of the rules on medical devices and in vitro diagnostic medical devices, and amending Regulation (EU) 2022/123 and Regulation (EU) 2024/1689
annotation.summary_en: European Commission proposal (December 2025) to simplify the Medical Devices and IVD Regulations, reducing administrative burden and notified-body involvement. It also moves the MDR and IVDR from Section A to Section B of Annex I of the EU AI Act, limiting AI Act application to AI-enabled medical devices, and adds cybersecurity incident reporting and regulatory sandboxes.
key_provisions_or_claims: Moves MDR and IVDR from Annex I Section A to Section B of the AI Act, limiting its application to AI-enabled medical devices.
Commission may set AI-specific requirements via delegated and implementing acts, taking account of AI Act Chapter III Section 2.
Notified bodies assessing high-risk AI medical devices must meet AI Act Article 31 requirements.
Reduces notified-body involvement for lower-risk devices and removes the maximum certificate validity period.
Introduces regulatory sandboxes and cybersecurity incident reporting to CSIRTs and ENISA through Eudamed.
